description: List folders with the full path already resolved — no need to walk parent_id yourself. Pass a folder's own id as parent_id to create_folder/update_folder to nest under it. Sorted by path, so a page is a contiguous slice of the tree read top to bottom; the reply is `{folders, has_more, next_offset?}`.

offset.description: Skip this many folders — pass back next_offset from the previous page

name: list_folders
